notice: Passage records are precise locators and claim boundaries, not copied source text. A registered locator does not prove that a candidate claim is correctly interpreted; the cited passage must be checked by a reviewer.

passages.claim_boundary: Defines the ADCS expansion and lists representative attitude sensors and actuators. It does not establish any spacecraft-specific fault or root cause.
Supports reaction-wheel torque and momentum storage, angular-momentum exchange, speed saturation, and redundancy considerations. It does not prove a particular wheel fault or bearing failure.

Describes residual fields in ferrous-core torquer bars/rods and their potential effect on magnetometers, and the use of magnetic torquers for wheel momentum desaturation. Do not generalize the rod construction to all magnetorquers.

Describes star-field visibility, field-of-view, angular-rate, external-light and glare conditions that can corrupt or invalidate a solution, and IMU propagation between star-tracker updates. It does not identify the cause of a particular invalid measurement.

States that a magnetometer cannot differentiate magnetic-field sources and that reaction wheels, magnetic torquer rods, power systems, cabling harnesses and solar cells can change the local field. This is not a unique root-cause signature.

Describes body-frame Sun-direction estimates, the need for another independent attitude source for a three-axis estimate, and possible albedo/glint measurement perturbations. It does not prove a specific sensor failure.
Defines gyroscope/accelerometer roles, IMU propagation between non-inertial sensor updates, and the need to estimate turn-on bias and bias drift. It does not set universal fault thresholds.

passages.locator: NASA/TP-20230005922, GN&C Best Practice #5, printed page 68
passages.claim_boundary: Supports independence of autonomous GN&C fault management from hardware/software involved in causing or diagnosing faults, including the warning against using the same gyro to monitor a control loop that uses it. It is a design principle, not a specific ADCS fault signature.

passages.locator: 卫星科普：卫星姿态控制，§如何控制卫星姿态，HTML lines 62-77
passages.claim_boundary: Provides Chinese-language descriptions of the sensor-controller-actuator loop and common sensor/actuator names. It is educational material, not a normative terminology standard or fault-diagnosis case.
Supports the project's data-model distinctions only; it does not establish domain-standard terminology or physical causality.
